explanation: The Iliad covers a few weeks in the war's tenth year and ends with Hector's funeral, before the city falls. The horse is recalled in the Odyssey and told in full in Virgil's Aeneid.

claims.text: Homer's Iliad does not tell the story of the wooden horse; the poem ends before the fall of Troy.
The Iliad covers a few weeks in the tenth year of the Trojan War.
The Iliad ends with the funeral of Hector.
The wooden horse is recalled in Homer's Odyssey and told in full in Virgil's Aeneid.
